title: License a private psychiatric facility
what: Operate a private psychiatric facility only under a licence.

sources.title: Mental Health Act 2015 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 224(1) (current republication (R22, from 16 April 2026; Mental Health Act 2015 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if the person— (a) operates a private psychiatric facility; and (b) does not hold a licence to operate the facility
